channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: OpenAI releases its official report on the Hugging Face breach
item.description: The report, which spans several discrete cybersecurity compromises, is the most complete accounting of the incident to date.

item.title: Samsung leak reveals Galaxy Aero smartwatch-lite — and it could right the wrongs of Samsung’s disappointing Apple Watch SE rival
item.description: A leak has revealed hints pointing towards a low-cost Samsung Galaxy Aero smartwatch.

item.title: 1666 : Amsterdam | Fin d’une longue bataille « très personnelle » pour le père d’Assassin’s Creed
item.description: À 52 ans, le créateur de la saga Assassin’s Creed lance 1666 : Amsterdam, un projet qui a survécu à la faillite de son premier éditeur et à une bataille judiciaire avec son ancien employeur, Ubisoft.

item.title: Devolver Digital squares up to Rockstar with a mascot platformer out the same day as GTA 6
item.description: Devolver Digital squares up to Rockstar with a mascot platformer out the same day as GTA 6.

item.title: Ring introduces better default encryption standards to address privacy concerns
item.description: Ring data still gets sent to the cloud, but it'll be deleted after being used to power smart home controls.

item.title: ASUS introduces new Ace esports-focused gaming monitors
item.description: The latest ASUS gaming monitors all feature 24.5-inch, high-refresh rate OLED panels.

item.title: Flipboard acquires Graze, the feed builder working to monetize the open social web
item.description: Flipboard is acquiring Bluesky feed-building startup Graze, bringing its privacy-friendly ad technology and creator monetization tools into Flipboard’s growing open social web ecosystem.

item.title: There Are No Trans Women in the WNBA, so Right-Wingers Are Making Some Up
item.description: As culture warriors continue to stoke the flames of a gender panic in professional sports, wild conspiracy theories are coming into play.

item.title: Medical device maker Boston Scientific says a cyberattack is causing a ‘global disruption’ to its operations
item.description: The company won't say if medical devices are affected or if any customer data was exfiltrated.

item.title: Security expert hijacks Apple's Find My network to share data with a Linux device
item.description: Researcher tricks Apple's Find My into feeding live location data to a Linux box, with no Mac or iPhone required.

item.title: The Humanoids at China’s Robot Games Were Faster Than Usain Bolt—but I’m More Impressed by Their Tweezer Mastery
item.description: Beijing’s endlessly delightful Robot Games featured tons of impressive stunts. But the most mind-blowing tricks challenged the humanoid’s brain, not its brawn.

item.title: Being a mom is hard — the heat is making it harder
item.description: It's 8:52 AM and 86 degrees Fahrenheit (30 Celsius) where I live in Southern California. My husband just came back from a morning outing with our four-month-old. item.title: « Elle était presque invisible » : cette comète a soudain multiplié son éclat par 20 000 et fascine les astronomes !
item.description: Plusieurs comètes passent régulièrement dans le Système solaire interne, en deçà de Jupiter, mais elles passent inaperçues pour l'amateur qui n'est pas équipé d'une lunette astronomique ou d'un petit télescope. Les autres ont parfois la chance d'observer des comportements inattendus de ces...

item.title: The Switch 2’s $50 price increase is happening next week
item.description: This is a friendly reminder that the Nintendo Switch 2 will jump in price by $50 starting on September 1st. That’s next Tuesday! The company gave plenty of notice, but the time has finally come. The base 256GB model that ships without a game will go from $449.99 to $499.99. Nintendo recently announced two bundles […]

item.title: FBI Disrupts Chinese Proxy Tools Used in Mass Hacking of US Agencies and Infrastructure
item.description: China’s hacking campaign targeted NASA, the Federal Reserve, the US Senate, the Justice Department, and more, according to the DOJ.

item.title: Meta reportedly abandoned an AI-focused restructuring plan that would have laid off thousands
item.description: The problem with Meta's AI restructuring plan is the AI wasn't good enough.

item.title: Apple Maps has ads now
item.description: Ads have started popping up in Apple Maps, following Apple's announcement in March that it would let businesses pay for top spots. item.title: GTA VI Cyberleek update: Everything leaked Wednesday and earlier this week
item.description: The 'Grand Theft Auto VI' leaks are starting to resemble a river at this point.

item.title: Google says its latest Gemini transcription model can turn your ramblings into structured text
item.description: Google says Gemini 3.5 Transcribe will soon let you use speech-to-text in any web field in Chrome.

item.title: Candidates Are Signing a Pact Promising Action on Data Centers and AI Safety
item.description: More than 15 politicians from across the country have signed on to the AI Pact, vowing to regulate data centers and AI. “We’ve got to get this right,” says Senate candidate Dan Osborn of Nebraska.

item.title: Apple officially announces September iPhone launch event: Surprise and shine
item.description: On Aug. 26, Apple finally confirmed the exact date and time of its annual September iPhone launch event.

item.title: The long-lasting Nothing Headphone (a) have never been this cheap before — save 45% for one day only
item.description: The black Nothing Headphone (a) are on sale for just $109 at Amazon and Best Buy today (Aug. 26) — an unprecedented 45% savings.

item.title: ShinyHunters hackers claim to have hit data center provider used by Microsoft and Meta
item.description: The hackers are asking for $13 million from CyrusOne, and have given the company a four-day deadline to comply.

item.title: Intelligence artificielle | Bill Gates propose de réserver des emplois aux humains et d’instaurer une taxe
item.description: L’ancien patron de Microsoft Bill Gates a appelé mercredi à un accompagnement du changement induit par l’intelligence artificielle (IA), proposant une taxe sur l’IA, la création d’une instance internationale et la désignation d’emplois réservés aux humains.

item.title: Bill Gates proposes a token tax on AI to protect human workers
item.description: Former Microsoft head Bill Gates has a few ideas on how to deal with AI replacing human workers.
